name: get_call_context
description: Call once at the start of every call. Returns which number was dialed (dialed_line is CA_MAIN for the Canada main line, otherwise US_MAIN), the caller's phone number (ani), and the current Eastern Time (current_time_et, day_of_week).

name: authenticate_merchant
description: Verify the caller. Always pass merchant_id plus exactly one second factor: first try ani (the caller's phone number from get_call_context); if that fails, try postal_code. Returns authenticated true/false and, on success, merchant_name. On failure it never says which value didn't match.

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID as spoken or keyed by the caller, digits only.

ani.description: Caller's phone number from get_call_context. Use on the first attempt.

postal_code.description: Business US zip code or Canadian postal code. Use on the second attempt.

name: get_account_status
description: Only call after authenticate_merchant succeeds. Returns collections_hold.active, fraud_hold (active, placed_date, placed_date_spoken, days_since_placed), and bank_account_update_case (open, bank_account_last4). Use placed_date_spoken verbatim when reading the hold date. A fraud hold is 'recent' when days_since_placed is 4 or less.

name: is_business_hours
description: Returns open true/false for a specialist queue. Collections and Fraud specialists work Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time. Also returns hours_spoken for telling callers the hours.

name: create_callback_case
description: Open a bank account update verification callback case (category 'ECC-Advanced Merchant Support', type 'DDA Research', origin 'IVR') for the caller's chosen window. Returns case_id and window_spoken to use in the confirmation.

window.description: morning = 7 to 10 AM, midday = 10 AM to 2 PM, afternoon = 2 to 6 PM.

name: transfer
description: Transfer the call. Use collections or fraud for specialist transfers (only during business hours); use the other queues for main menu services. Say the handoff line to the caller before calling this.

queue.description: Main menu keys: batch_transaction_deposit=2, terminal_support=3, statements_account_changes=4, disputes_chargebacks=5, voice_authorization=6, government_public_sector=8.

reason.description: One-line summary for the receiving specialist, e.g. 'Authenticated merchant 4472190, fraud hold placed Oct 28, 7 days in review.'
